description: A shell script to test fetching remote-tracking branches in a Git repository, including setup steps and fetch verification.

methods.name: test_expect_success setup
methods.description: Sets up initial Git repository, commits, branches, and configures a remote repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success fetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch from the remote repository and verifies that the remote-tracking branch is correctly updated.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
